fields.description:
## Context / Problem

The shipped completion-recovery design fans out one ISOLATED evidence run per criterion after a primary-run failure. The operator has ruled this an unapproved design overreach: it explodes token cost (c9f7 shape: 22 criteria x 20-request budget = 440 requests worst case, 1.8x the primary's own 240-request budget) and wall-clock cost (sequential 25-90s per criterion), re-sends the full ticket context uncached per criterion (2.67M chars for c9f7), and has no optimization for overlapping or small criteria. Meanwhile verified work from the PRIMARY run is discarded wholesale when it fails: a run that verified 20 of 22 criteria before exhausting re-does everything. And when recovery itself dies, the run ends verdict-less — the --force-close trap.

## Approach

Replace the per-criterion fan-out (completion_recovery.py _recover, deleted not dead-coded) with banked incremental verification at the CompletionAgentStep seam (completion_recovery.py:451+). All numbered evidence below was confirmed by reading the tree at the cited lines.

**Criterion identity.** Deterministic ID minted at run start: `c<two-digit index>-<sha256(normalized verbatim text)[:8]>` (normalization: whitespace-collapse + casefold). explicit_completion_criteria (completion_recovery.py:84) is a deterministic, deduped, document-order parse, so primary and successor mint identical IDs from the same material. Bank entries carry BOTH the id and the verbatim string; the final completion_verdict still keys by verbatim string (schema unchanged). The id keys the bank, the record tool's schema, the successor prompt's remainder listing, and a reworked coverage validation that accepts the banked-union-successor set by ID, order-insensitive (today's _validate_coverage, completion_recovery.py:354, requires ordered full-list equality and cannot accept a remainder-scoped result; its retry-on-missing behavior is preserved).

**Run-scoped bank.** Lives in a run-unique git-ignored dir `.rebar/workflow_runs/<run_id>/bank/` (run_id exists, workflow/executor.py:71), so concurrent closes cannot collide; no cross-run reuse — the staleness surface is too large for a signed gate. Fail-loud (any read/write error aborts recovery with a typed error), schema-versioned, idempotent upsert by criterion_id. Each entry stamps ticket id, ticket-material fingerprint (the same provenance seam _commands/transition_close.py already imports), and the resolved verification tree sha (for a --ref close, the resolved ref's tree — the same tree the signature retargets to, _lib_writes.py:370). The successor preflight re-resolves all three stamps and fails loud on any mismatch. The bank dir is discarded after finalize; the emitted verdict/sidecar embeds the banked evidence uncompressed so the audit trail survives it.

**Primary run.** Gains a `record_criterion_verdict` tool wired through a new explicit constructor/step-input seam on CompletionAgentStep feeding RunRequest.extra_tools (the dormant field built for this; runner.py:347-348 appends it — the primary RunRequest is built inside RunnerAgentStep.run, workflow/runs.py:144). The system prompt (reviewers/completion_verifier.md) instructs INCREMENTAL banking — record each criterion's verdict as soon as its evidence is sufficient — and states that banked verdicts are PROVISIONAL AND REVISABLE (re-recording overwrites; the idempotent upsert supports it), with the final structured output remaining the authoritative full-list judgment on success. This reconciles mid-run banking with the batched-judging research's reason-across-all-criteria-before-committing recommendation. Each banked entry's evidence is capped at banking time at 3,000 chars (sized net of finalizer prompt overhead and criteria text: _MAX_FINALIZER_INPUT_CHARS = 132,000 (completion_recovery.py:70) minus _MAX_TOTAL_CRITERIA_CHARS = 32,000 and prompt overhead, divided by _MAX_CRITERIA = 32 (completion_recovery.py:41)); a capped entry carries an explicit truncated=true flag — the audit trail declares partial evidence rather than leaving it discoverable only by measuring lengths (this cap deliberately replaces the oversize-evidence fail-loud at completion_recovery.py:346-351). The cap is enforced by the tool and stated to the model. Precedence: on primary SUCCESS the final structured output is authoritative exactly as today; the bank is consulted ONLY on typed failure — no behavior change for healthy runs.

**Successor runs.** On typed primary failure (LLMBudgetExhausted | RunawayToolLoop | token-exhaustion UnretryableOutput — the three CompletionAgentStep already catches): batched successor runs over the UNVERIFIED remainder.
- Batch cap is model-class-aware (resolved via model_classes.py): <=8 criteria/batch on Sonnet-class (the default verifier), <=12 on frontier-class — research ground: FARA-style whole-rubric 12-15 is frontier-only, mid-tier caps at 6-8.
- Runs = ceil(remainder/cap), sequential, each ONE batched agentic run — never per-criterion. Worst case today: 22 remainder on Sonnet -> 3 runs.
- Successors carry the SAME record_criterion_verdict tool and incremental-banking instruction: a successor dying mid-run in a typed failure keeps its banked progress; only still-unbanked criteria count as no-progress. On successor success its structured output is harvested into the bank via the same idempotent upsert (tool-banked and output-harvested entries converge; re-harvest is a no-op).
- BUDGET POOL, denominated in MODEL REQUESTS. N = the primary's req_limit as computed by build_usage_limits (structured_run.py:452: req_limit = ceil(eff_max_iter/2)); completion floors eff_max_iter at _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS = 480 (completion.py:86,523-524), so N = 240 today. Global total = completion.recovery_pool_multiplier x N (new config key, default 1.5) = 360 worst case; successor pool = global - primary spend (from the typed failure's failure_usage.requests diagnostic, structured_run.py:84-137), so a fully-exhausted primary leaves 120 requests. Honest empirical anchor: the only whole-ticket instrumented datum (the non-looping instrumented run: 14 criteria, 258 tool calls, 238 distinct) DIED budget-exhausted verdict-less, as did all four instrumented runs at 257-270 calls — that shows whole-ticket verification can consume a full primary budget; it does not show 120 suffices for successors. The sufficiency argument is structural: successor batches carry <=8 criteria not the full list; banked verdicts arrive as one-line read-only summaries so completed work is not re-verified; and the failure mode when 120 is not enough is benign by construction — the run degrades to a full-coverage verdict with unverified met=false placeholders, a scored outcome, never the trap. The 1.5 default is an economics dial (config-tunable); unit tests pin the arithmetic against the true numbers (N=240, pool=360, successor pool=120).
- Per-run allocation: each of the R planned runs gets floor(pool_remaining / runs_remaining) — run 1 cannot drain runs 2..R; later runs inherit unspent budget. Success-path spend seam: pydantic-ai run usage is already extracted post-run (runner.py:538); this ticket returns it to CompletionAgentStep on the run result so inheritance sees actual successor spend.
- Unit conversion at the seam: iteration_limit is in ITERATIONS and build_usage_limits derives req_limit = ceil(eff_max_iter/2), so a successor granted B requests sets iteration_limit = 2 x B (passing B raw would silently halve every successor budget). B > N clamps at N: iteration_limit is min-only against cfg.max_iterations (structured_run.py:447-448), so allocation is capped at N per run.
- No-launch guard, batch-aware: a batch of k criteria needs >= 2k tool calls (>=1 read + 1 bank each) and tool_calls_limit = max(8, 2xB) (structured_run.py:455), so the launch floor is B >= 2 x batch_size. Below it, shrink the batch to floor(B/2) and re-plan (re-computing the per-run allocation after each shrink; terminates — batch size strictly decreases); when even a 1-criterion batch (B < 2) cannot launch, stop and finalize with what is banked (the max(2,·) floor at structured_run.py:448 would otherwise grant a doomed 1-request run at pool 0).
- Scoping: remainder criteria listed by ID; banked verdicts as read-only one-line summaries; FULL ticket context unchanged (no elision). Deliberate deviation from pydantic-ai message_history resume: a clean-scoped successor avoids resuming a history that just looped 144x (poisoned attention); the re-paid context cost is accepted and mitigated by the cache note below.
- Structured output: required per-criterion fields keyed by ID + retry-on-missing (the _validate_coverage retry precedent).
- Zero-progress breaker: a successor banking nothing new (neither tool nor harvest) stops recovery; control passes to the finalizer with whatever the bank holds.

**Finalizer & verdict coverage** (existing tool-free finalizer, completion_recovery.py:545+):
- If ANY verdicts are banked, it ALWAYS emits a FULL-COVERAGE verdict: verified criteria scored from banked evidence; unverified criteria as met=false placeholders explicitly marked exhausted/unverified (content-free counters only). The deterministic backstop guarantees an exhausted placeholder can never score met=true. The verdict-less --force-close trap is closed for every state with progress.
- Deterministic no-LLM fallback: if the LLM finalizer itself fails, retry it once; if it fails again, assemble the verdict DIRECTLY from the bank with no model call — banked met flags as-is, unbanked criteria as met=false unverified placeholders, downgrade authority skipped and recorded as skipped. A run with banked progress can NEVER die verdict-less. The fallback verdict closes the ticket but is marked finalizer=deterministic_fallback and is NOT certification-eligible (the cross-criterion downgrade review never ran; reuses the existing certified-vs-uncertified close distinction that child_closure_findings applies, completion.py:90-193); the upgrade path is the existing reopen -> re-close flow.
- Downgrade authority over banked PASSes on cross-criterion contradiction (banked-PASS revision is unsolved community-wide; this is the mitigation).
- Receives uncompressed evidence (byte-identity pinned, subject only to the banking-time per-entry cap with its truncated flag).
- The ONE remaining verdict-less state — zero banked verdicts total — stays a typed CompletionRecoveryError + gate_error sidecar, deliberately: an all-placeholder FAIL would conflate not-done with not-verified on a signed gate; zero progress signals pathology needing diagnosis. The incremental-banking live AC below is what makes this state rare.

**Cache.** Successors reuse the primary's system prompt + tool definitions verbatim (engine-wide cache_instructions + cache_tool_definitions are already on, capabilities.py:684-696 => cache hits). A CachePoint is placed after the fenced ticket-context block via the message-tail caching arm (capabilities.py, gated on execution_mode="agentic") so primary and successors share the context cache; its hit rate is measured in the live validation AC.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py — delete the per-criterion fan-out; criterion IDs; successor batching + budget pool; finalizer full-coverage + deterministic fallback; reworked coverage validation.
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_banking.py — new: run-scoped bank store + record_criterion_verdict tool (stamps, caps, idempotent upsert, truncated flag).
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py — constructor/step-input seam passing the per-run toolset into RunRequest.extra_tools.
- src/rebar/llm/runner.py — return extracted run usage on the run result (success-path spend seam).
- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md — incremental provisional banking instruction.
- src/rebar/_config_schema.py — completion.recovery_pool_multiplier key.
- tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_banking.py — new: bank semantics, pool arithmetic, coverage merge, fallback.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] K-of-N survival: with K banked verdicts and a typed primary failure, the emitted verdict scores those K from banked evidence and the remaining N-K are covered by successors or explicit met=false unverified placeholders — full coverage, never verdict-less (unit tests).
- [ ] Remainder scoping: successor prompts list only unbanked criterion IDs; banked criteria appear only as one-line read-only summaries (unit test on prompt assembly).
- [ ] Coverage-merge validates the banked-union-successor set by criterion ID, order-insensitive, retry-on-missing preserved (unit tests).
- [ ] Stamp mismatch fails loud: a successor preflight over a bank whose ticket/material/tree stamp differs aborts with a typed error naming the mismatched stamp (unit test).
- [ ] Pool arithmetic pinned in request units: N=240, global=360, exhausted-primary successor pool=120; iteration_limit set to 2x the granted requests; allocation floor(pool/runs_remaining); batch-aware no-launch floor B >= 2 x batch_size with batch-shrink re-planning (unit tests over the arithmetic, no LLM).
- [ ] Zero-progress breaker: a successor banking nothing new stops recovery and finalizes from the bank; zero banked total remains a typed CompletionRecoveryError + gate_error sidecar (unit tests).
- [ ] Deterministic fallback: finalizer forced to fail twice with a non-empty bank yields a full-coverage verdict marked finalizer=deterministic_fallback, not certification-eligible, never verdict-less (unit test).
- [ ] The per-criterion fan-out is removed: no code path in completion_recovery.py launches one LLM run per criterion (grep + unit suite).
- [ ] Verdict/sidecar embeds banked evidence with per-entry truncated flags where the 3,000-char cap bit; single-event size bounded by cap x _MAX_CRITERIA (unit test).
- [ ] Incremental-banking live AC: a live Bedrock run with an induced exhaustion (iteration_limit lowered on a multi-criterion ticket) shows the PRIMARY banked >=1 verdict before dying (recorded on this ticket).
- [ ] Healthy-path quality: verdict class unchanged pre- vs post-banking-prompt across >=3 healthy multi-criterion already-closed tickets, greedy decoding pinned per e458 (recorded on this ticket).
- [ ] Spend below fan-out: the live exhaustion run's total requests (primary + successors) is below the 440-request fan-out worst case for the same criteria count (usage-log figures recorded on this ticket).
- [ ] make lint and make typecheck pass; unit marker suite matches the pre-existing baseline.

## Testing

Held-out unit oracle RED-first in tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_banking.py: bank idempotency/stamps/caps/truncated flag, criterion-ID minting, coverage merge (success, remainder, missing-field retry), pool arithmetic including the 2x conversion and shrink re-planning, zero-progress breaker, deterministic fallback (finalizer failure injected), fan-out absence. Run: python -m pytest tests/unit/workflow/ -q. Live Bedrock experiments per the three live ACs recorded as ticket comments with usage-log figures. make lint + make typecheck.
